text:
jiang: Quick intake — new model 'atlas-11b' landed on model-registry. Need prioritization and bench/quality bring-up plan. Who can own perf baseline + quant smoke?

olivia: tagging core checklist: throughput baseline, latency P50/P95, batch sweep, ctx sweep, quant int8/int4 smoke, and quality eval on our standard prompt set. recommend high-priority if team wants dedicated capacity soon :eyes:

dan: agree with olivia. Add stability tests (long convo KV cache + repeated decode) and memory regression (GPU mem peak). Also add A/B against prod-13b on throughput & perplexity.

maria: I can run latency/throughput baselines this week. Plan: bs=[1,2,4,8,16], ctx=[512,1024,2048,4096], tokens=256. I'll log p50/p95/p99 and token/sec.

sara: I'll do quant smoke for int8 and int4 (GPTQ and AWQ) on a single node. Quick plan:
```
bench run --model atlas-11b --quant int8,int4 --batch-sizes 1,2,4 --ctx 1024 --tokens 128 --save-artifacts
```
I'll drop artifacts in /mnt/bench/artifacts/atlas-11b-quant/

leo: I'll run quality evals (llm-eval harness) vs prod-13b on our conversational + code prompts. Will report rouge/acc/hel-pair diffs and flag any regression >3%.

perf-bot: job queued: bench-1802123501 (owner: maria) — estimated 4h. :white_check_mark:

jiang: thanks. Priority set to P1 for perf/onboarding. Owners: maria (perf baseline), sara (quant smoke), leo (quality eval). Dan to own stability/memory. Olivia will coordinate rollout policy and canary thresholds.

olivia: For canary thresholds, propose: latency p95 <= prod-13b * 1.15, token/sec within 90% of prod, quality delta <= 3% on key metrics. If quant -> fallback allowed. Agree?

dan: agree to thresholds. For quantized fallback, add automatic model-variant routing in config:
```
routing:
  failover: prod-13b
  conditions:
    - latency_p95 > threshold
    - quality_regression > 3
```

jiang: ok. Next steps: owners to drop initial artifacts in the ticket (#ML-2387) by EOD Wed. We'll reconvene Thu 10am for triage. :calendar:

maria: copying plan to ticket now. :rocket:

sara: starting quant smoke in ~30m.

leo: starting eval run after sara's smoke completes.
